item.title: aquamarine5 / ChaoxingSignFaker
item.description: 伪造学习通的签到活动🙋学习通签到神器。支持滑动验证码签到、签退、人脸识别功能，支持自定义位置签到、动态二维码签到、自选照片进行拍照签到等全部签到形式以及给其他用户无限代签的功能 Falsifying the signing activity of Chaoxing, supporting slide captcha and signing out, and location-signing by custom position, selecting a picture from gallery for photo-signing and all types. Also supported signing for infinite accounts in only one device
